title: Pause and resume all AGV movement using PauseAGVs / ResumeAGVs API requests
summary: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API client (Apidog / WCS API) to send fleet-level PauseAGVs and ResumeAGVs requests to Geek. PauseAGVs pauses all AGV movement; ResumeAGVs resumes the paused AGVs. Confirm each request shows an observable success/acceptance result in the API client.
when_to_use: When you need to pause all AGV movement fleet-wide (PauseAGVs) or resume the paused fleet (ResumeAGVs) by sending the correct API request to Geek, and you can observe the request/response outcome in the OptiSweep / WCS API client.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the PauseAGVs / ResumeAGVs API requests using the OptiSweep / WCS API client and verify the request outcome is successful/accepted in the client.
safety_notes: This procedure is a fleet-level movement pause/resume action via API requests to Geek.
access_or_tools_needed: Apidog / WCS API client (or equivalent OptiSweep / WCS API client surface)

access_required: Access to the OptiSweep / WCS API client surface (Apidog / WCS API)
system_preconditions: Geek is reachable via the OptiSweep / WCS API client so that PauseAGVs / ResumeAGVs requests can be sent and a response can be observed.

visual_references.description: Frame showing the API function behavior text: PauseAGVs makes a request to Geek to pause all AGV movement; ResumeAGVs makes a request to Geek to resume all AGV movement.
